question: The United Nations estimated the number of poor people in India to be around _______ million in 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**364.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Two-thirds of the Indian population **is impoverished**: 68.8% of the Indian population** lives on** less than $2 a day.**
